name: Iran
overview: Scripture reveals Iran, historically known as Persia, as a significant kingdom under God's sovereign control, exemplified in the elevation of Mordecai during the Persian empire (Esther 10:2). The Medes and Persians are depicted as instruments of God's judgment, particularly against Babylon, demonstrating His authority over nations (Jeremiah 51:11). The prophetic word against Elam (Jeremiah 49:34) and the psalmist's cry for God to not remain silent amid hostile nations (Psalms 2:1; 83:1) remind believers of the spiritual realities behind earthly conflicts, underscoring the need to trust God's power and justice in the face of threats.
